title: Deck list handler returns every tenant's rows
description: The list handler selects from decks with no caller-derived predicate, so any authenticated user enumerates every tenant's decks.

title: Postgres connection does not verify the server certificate
description: postgres() is called with no ssl option, so the driver negotiates TLS without validating the server certificate chain.

title: Deck listing is authenticated but not authorized
description: Same defect as CAL-001, filed from the auth category — authentication is checked, per-row authorization is not.

title: Search filter interpolated into SQL
description: The filter string appears inside a tagged sql template; the interpolation is parameterised by the driver, so this is not injectable.

title: Sibling surface for deck-bytes enforces a weaker gate
description: A Vue click handler is compared against an HTTP RBAC gate on the same free-text resource name. The component cannot enforce a gate; the comparison is cross-layer and meaningless.

title: Refresh-grant curl targets a repo-chosen host
description: The refresh grant is POSTed to a host read from a repo-controlled variable, so a repo edit redirects a live credential.

title: Sibling surface for deck-bytes enforces a weaker gate (grid)
description: Restatement of CAL-008 at a second component. Triage folded the pair into each other and never reached a terminal verdict.

title: Sibling surface for deck-bytes enforces a weaker gate (list)
description: Restatement of CAL-007 at a third component. The two verdicts point at each other, which is the duplicate-cycle case.

title: Scope claim has no caller-derived predicate
description: The claimed predicate lives inside a tagged sql template, which _strip_literals blanked before scoring. The collection is correctly scoped.

title: Unscoped collection read (paired with the C5 rewrite)
description: C5 rewrote scope to unscoped, so C1 fired on the same row. Triage marked it DUPLICATE without naming a target.

title: Unscoped collection read on cost centres
description: Triage folded this into a finding id that does not exist in this run — a dangling duplicate reference.

title: V14.4 security headers incomplete
description: Some headers are set by the edge proxy, which the audit cannot see. The triager could not decide from source alone.

title: Profile endpoint returns full PII set
description: Explicitly parked by the triage rota — nobody looked at it, so it must not count toward any denominator.

title: CORS allows credentialed wildcard origin
description: No verdict row exists for this finding at all — the untriaged case, which must be reported as coverage rather than silently counted.

title: Hardcoded GitHub App signing key
description: semgrep generic-api-key rule; the literal is a real private key committed to the tree.

title: Capability-only egress leg (pre-v2.6 row, no rule_family)
description: This row predates the v2.6 rule_family field; the family must be inferred from sources[].detail so old runs stay measurable.

title: Deck list handler leaks cross-tenant rows (third filing)
description: Folds into CAL-003, which itself folds into CAL-001 — a two-hop duplicate chain that must resolve to REAL.
